recipes.name: Iskender Kebab
recipes.description: Bursa's legendary layered kebab: shaved spiced beef over pita with tomato sauce, yogurt and sizzling butter.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef slices in grated onion, oregano and oil; sear hard in batches.
Warm pita squares on a tray; spoon warm tomato sauce over.
Pile beef on top; add dollops of yogurt along one edge.
Pour foaming butter with pul biber over everything; serve immediately.

videos.videoTitle: Turkish Iskender Kebab! Everything You Need To Make At Home

recipes.name: Tas Kebabı
recipes.description: Old-Ottoman pot kebab: beef cubes braised until silky with onion and tomato, served over pilav.

steps.instruction: Brown beef in butter; add onions and cook until sweet and soft.
Stir in paste and pepper; cover with water.
Reduce sauce slightly; serve over buttered pilav.

videos.videoTitle: Tas Kebabi - Turkish traditional slow-cooked meat stew

recipes.name: İzmir Köfte
recipes.description: Cylindrical köfte baked in tomato sauce between potato rounds and bay - Aegean home classic.

steps.instruction: Knead meat with onion, crumbs, salt and pepper; shape fingers.
Shallow-fry köfte briefly; lightly brown potato rounds too.
Layer potatoes and köfte in a dish; pour seasoned passata around.
Bake at 190°C about 35 minutes until bubbling.

videos.videoTitle: Bu Tarifi Görenler İzmir Köfteyi Bir Daha Dışarıda Yemeyecek!

recipes.name: Etli Güveç
recipes.description: Beef and summer vegetables slow-baked in clay pots until everything melts together.

steps.instruction: Sear beef; place in güveç pots with oil and garlic.
Add vegetables, tomatoes, herbs and a splash of water.
Cover and bake at 170°C for 80 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes before serving straight from the pot.

videos.videoTitle: Traditional Turkish Stew (Etli Türlü / Güveç) With Vegan Option

recipes.name: Şiş Tavuk
recipes.description: Yogurt-and-tomato-paste marinated chicken skewers - the smoky king of Turkish grills.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken cubes at least 3 hours.
Grill hot, turning, 10-12 minutes until charred at edges.
Serve over lavaş with grilled peppers and rice.

recipes.name: Hünkar Beğendi
recipes.description: 'The Sultan delighted': smoky eggplant-bechamel purée under braised chicken stew.

steps.instruction: Char eggplants whole; peel and mash with lemon.
Make a thick béchamel; beat in cheese then eggplant.
Stew chicken with onion and paste until tender.
Spoon purée onto plates; crown with stew and its sauce.

recipes.name: Tavuk Döner
recipes.description: Marinated chicken stacked and roasted, shaved thin into wraps with pickles and garlic sauce.

steps.instruction: Marinate thighs overnight; stack tightly into a loaf and skewer.
Roast at 190°C 35-40 minutes, shaving crisp edges as they form.
Fill generously with döner shavings; roll tight and grill seam down.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Turkish Chicken Doner Kebab at Home

recipes.name: Tavuk Güveç
recipes.description: Chicken, mushrooms, peppers and tomatoes baked together in clay - weeknight Anatolia.

steps.instruction: Toss everything raw into güveç dishes with paste, oil, herbs, salt.
Add a finger of water; cover with foil.
Bake at 185°C for 45 minutes; uncover 10 to color.

recipes.name: İmam Bayıldı
recipes.description: 'The priest fainted': eggplant collapsed in olive oil with tomato, onion and garlic - served room temp.

steps.instruction: Fry eggplants in oil until softened; drain cut-side up in a dish.
Cook onions slowly in oil until melting; add garlic, tomatoes, sugar, salt.
Stuff eggplants with the mixture; add water to dish.
Bake 165°C 40 minutes; cool to room temperature before serving.

videos.videoTitle: LEGENDARY Recipes: Turkish Aubergines That Made Imams Faint

recipes.name: Mercimek Çorbası
recipes.description: Silky red lentil soup finished with minted chili butter - Turkey's daily first spoonful.

steps.instruction: Soften onion and carrot; stir in tomato paste.
Add lentils and stock; simmer 25 minutes until collapsing.
Blend very smooth; loosen to velvet consistency.
Crown each bowl with mint-chili butter; serve with lemon.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Turkish Lentil Soup (Mercimek Corbasi) – Easy Vegan Red Lentil Soup

recipes.name: Menemen
recipes.description: Eggs slow-scrambled through peppers and tomatoes - the Turkish breakfast non-negotiable.

steps.instruction: Cook peppers in fat until slumped; add tomatoes and reduce to jammy.
Beat eggs lightly and fold through gently - keep it saucy.
Optional feta crumbled in; eat straight from the pan with bread.

recipes.name: Zeytinyağlı Yaprak Sarma
recipes.description: Rice-and-currant-stuffed vine leaves cooked gently in olive oil - cold mezze perfection.

steps.instruction: Cook onions in oil till soft; add rice, nuts, currants, herbs, salt.
Pack in pot; cover with lemon-water and a weight.
Simmer low ~45 minutes; cool fully before serving.

recipes.name: Turkish Baklava
recipes.description: Forty gossamer phyllo layers, clarified butter, walnut filling and cool sugar syrup - pastry as heritage.

steps.instruction: Boil syrup ingredients 10 minutes; cool completely.
Butter and layer half the phyllo, spreading walnuts midway.
Cut diamond shapes to the bottom before baking.
Bake 170°C ~45 min gold; pour COLD syrup over HOT baklava; rest overnight.

videos.videoTitle: Baklava Recipe | How to Make Baklava

recipes.name: Künefe
recipes.description: Shredded kadayif wrapped around stretching cheese, soaked in syrup while screaming hot.

steps.instruction: Work butter through kadayif; press half into a buttered round pan.
Spread cheese layer; cap with remaining kadayif.
Cook stovetop 12-15 minutes per side, pressing, until deep gold.
Pour warm syrup over immediately; pistachio shower; serve hot.
